verdict.rationale: Per-contact automation visibility, plus manual unenroll and re-enroll, is a fair question for a marketing automation suite, so the axis applies. The pack only mentions setting up simple post-send workflows and aggregate customer-journey analytics. Neither shows where an individual contact sits in a workflow or how to pull them out or re-enter them without disrupting the flow.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see where any individual person sits inside an automation and pull or re-enter them without breaking the flow
